failure_reason: Akamai edge rate-limit block ('Access Denied', errors.edgesuite.net) hit after ~24 successful Chrome navigations, triggered by a browser_batch of 5 rapid back-to-back page loads with no pacing gap. Confirmed persistent (not a cache artifact) by retrying a never-before-fetched leaf URL (sideboards, c:29883) standalone, which returned Access Denied with a fresh edge reference number. Per the hard-block rule, stopped all further requests to argos.co.uk. Fully verified (rendered-header qty + evidence) only two of Argos's many furniture rooms: Bedroom Furniture and Living Room Furniture. Not yet verified: 8 more Living Room Furniture leaf nodes (Console Tables c:29884, Nest of Tables c:797720, Sideboards c:29883, Display Cabinets c:29886, Bookcases and Shelving c:29894, CD and DVD Storage c:29895, Living Room Furniture Sets c:29882, Wall Mounted and Floating Shelves c:29896 -- these were identified from the category page's own tile links but no quantities were captured), plus entire Dining Room, Kitchen Furniture, Storage & Organisation (bookcases/storage units subset), Office Furniture, Bathroom Furniture, Kids Room furniture, and Garden Furniture (Garden & DIY department) rooms, all of which have furniture-relevant nodes identified in the site's mega-menu taxonomy (window.__INITIAL_HEADER_STATE__.taxonomy) but zero rows were extracted for them. A fresh session/tab against this same site should very likely succeed with proper pacing (~1 request per 5-8s, no batched rapid-fire navigation) since the earlier HTTP-only block that a prior pass hit does NOT apply here -- Chrome reached the site cleanly for the first ~24 requests.
notes: ACCESS: robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (checked first). Site loaded cleanly via Chrome for the homepage and ~20+ category pages before an Akamai rate-limit landed -- this contradicts the prior Home-Decor pass's total-block finding, which was based on curl_cffi/WebFetch/jina/translate.goog, all now-forbidden routes; a real Chrome tab works fine here as long as requests are paced. TREE SOURCE: window.__INITIAL_HEADER_STATE__.taxonomy (full JSON on the homepage, includes far more than the visible mega-menu DOM) gave the Home & Furniture and Garden & DIY department structures. Cross-checked against each hub category page's own SSR tile links via same-origin fetch+regex for Bedroom and Living Room specifically (7b Rule #1 confirmed live: the mega-menu listed only 6 Living Room Furniture children, but the category page itself linked 18 -- the extra 12 were only discoverable by walking the category page, not the nav). QTY METHOD: rendered listing-page header text (e.g. '425 products') captured via get_page_text after navigate -- this is the verified-reliable source. The site's own __NEXT_DATA__.props.pageProps.categoryData.attributes.productsInCategory field (reachable via same-origin fetch without navigating) was tested and found UNRELIABLE: it returned 311 for Bed frames (c:29867) vs the rendered page's true 425 -- so it was NOT used for any qty in this file; every qty here came from an actual page navigation + rendered header read. STRUCTURE: 'Beds' (c:29865) is a hub with two orthogonal, overlapping facets over the identical underlying bed products -- 'Beds by Type' (Bed frames, Divan beds, Ottoman and storage beds, Folding and guest beds, Kids beds, Day beds) and 'Beds by Size' (Single/Small double/Double/King/Super king). Recorded only the by-Type facet as the true subcategory tree (matches the deepest-useful-node / no-duplicate-products principle); the by-Size facet was skipped as a redundant filter over the same catalogue, not a genuine additional category. Headboards (c:1043143) was also a child of the Beds hub and is explicitly furniture per brief Section 1; Mattresses and Mattress toppers (siblings of Headboards under Beds) were excluded as bedding, not furniture, per brief. EXCLUSIONS applied within the two completed rooms: Bedding (c:29358) and Mattresses (c:29870) under Bedroom Furniture excluded as bedding. Nothing excluded within Living Room Furniture's 10 verified leaves -- all are genuine furniture types (sofas, seating, tables, media units, bean bags/footstools filed as living-room seating furniture, drinks trolleys/bar carts as furniture). SANITY CHECKS: h1/breadcrumb on every leaf page matched the requested node (e.g. 'Bedside tables' breadcrumb on the bedside-tables URL); counts varied node-to-node (46 to 1059), ruling out a constant site-wide placeholder; none were suspiciously round. Two Beds-hub numbers are large (663 for Ottoman and storage beds, 425 for Bed frames) but each had its own distinct multi-page pagination ('Page 1 of 12', 'Page 1 of 8') visibly confirming a real, non-capped count.
